lyrics.ti:
[[chorus]]
ተንሲኡ ክርስቶስ ብዘደንቕ ክብሪ/2/
ዜና ትንሳኤኡ ተዋህዶ መስክሪ/2/
[[/chorus]]

ንኣዳም ንምድኃን ተንሲኡ ብክብሪ
ቃልኪዳን ኣትዩሉ [[highlight]]ተንሲኡ ብክብሪ[[/highlight]]
ጊዜኡ ሓልዩ [[highlight]]ተንሲኡ ብክብሪ[[/highlight]]
ካሕሳ ከፊሉሉ [[highlight]]ተንሲኡ ብክብሪ[[/highlight]]
ካብ ሰማይ ወሪዱ ዝተሰቐለሉ
ንሞት ስዒሩ ብኽብሪ ተንሲኡ

ማርያም መግደላዊት ተንሲኡ ብክብሪ
ብለይቲ ገስጊሳ [[highlight]]ተንሲኡ ብክብሪ[[/highlight]]
ንብሕታ ከደት [[highlight]]ተንሲኡ ብክብሪ[[/highlight]]
ክትደሊ ኣምላኻ [[highlight]]ተንሲኡ ብክብሪ[[/highlight]]
ዝተንገላትዐ ኣብቲ ጎልጎታ
ምስረኸበቶ ተመሊኣ ደስታ

ሓለውቲ መቓብር ተንሲኡ ብክብሪ
እቶም ኣይሁዳውያን [[highlight]]ተንሲኡ ብክብሪ[[/highlight]]
ክርስቶስ ክሕዙ [[highlight]]ተንሲኡ ብክብሪ[[/highlight]]
መኺርዎም ሰይጣን [[highlight]]ተንሲኡ ብክብሪ[[/highlight]]
ዙርያ እቲ መቓብር ብዙኃት ከቢቦም
ፍጹም ኣይከኣሉን ከም ቆጽሊ ረጊፎም

ምስጋና ነቕርብ ተንሲኡ ብክብሪ
ንፈጣሪ ኢየሱስ [[highlight]]ተንሲኡ ብክብሪ[[/highlight]]
ንሞት ዝሰዓረ [[highlight]]ተንሲኡ ብክብሪ[[/highlight]]
ንደቁ ክቕድስ [[highlight]]ተንሲኡ ብክብሪ[[/highlight]]
ደስ ይበለና ንዘምር ኩልና
ብርሃን ተኸዲኑ ጎይታ ተንሲኡልና
lyrics.ti_ro:
[[chorus]]
Tensiʾu Kristos bizedenqh kibri/2/
Zena tinsaʾeʾu tewahdo meskiri/2/
[[/chorus]]

Niʾadam nimdihan tensiʾu bikbiri

Gizeʾu halyu [[highlight]]tensiʾu bikbiri[[/highlight]]
Kahsa kefilulu [[highlight]]tensiʾu bikbiri[[/highlight]]
Kab semay weridu ziteseqhelelu
Nimot siʿiru bikhbiri tensiʾu

Maryam megdelawit tensiʾu bikbiri
Bileyti gesgisa [[highlight]]tensiʾu bikbiri[[/highlight]]
Nibhita kedet [[highlight]]tensiʾu bikbiri[[/highlight]]
Kitdeli ʾamlakha [[highlight]]tensiʾu bikbiri[[/highlight]]
Zitengelatʿa ʾabti Golgota

Halewti meqhabr tensiʾu bikbiri
ʾItom ʾayhudawyan [[highlight]]tensiʾu bikbiri[[/highlight]]
Kristos kihzu [[highlight]]tensiʾu bikbiri[[/highlight]]
Mekhirwom seyt'an [[highlight]]tensiʾu bikbiri[[/highlight]]
Zurya ʾiti meqhabr bizuhat kebibom
Fitsum ʾaykeʾalun kem qotsli regifom

Misgana neqhrib tensiʾu bikbiri
Nifet'ari Iyesus [[highlight]]tensiʾu bikbiri[[/highlight]]
Nimot ziseʿare [[highlight]]tensiʾu bikbiri[[/highlight]]
Nidequ kiqhdis [[highlight]]tensiʾu bikbiri[[/highlight]]
Des yibelena nizemr kulna
Birhan tekhedinu goyta tensiʾulna
